Their original hashes and records are preserved; saved likelihood/prior values and sampler densities provide direct target references. Numerical agreement is checked at MAP, chain endpoints and coordinate extrema, not asserted for every possible parameter value.

interpretation: compatibility evidence for these retained targets and checked points, not replacement producer provenance or proof for arbitrary source changes
